page.title: Codex usage optimiser
page.description: An experimental Codex cost calculator, with a local usage report preview and optional contributions.
page.intro: I wanted to see what keeping Codex coding might cost, though these estimates still use assumed capacities and prices, so the community reports are a starting point.
page.contributeIntro: Generate a report on your computer, check the monthly totals here, and decide whether to share it, with GitHub attribution as a separate choice after signing in.
page.peopleEmpty: Profiles appear after review, with separate permission from each person, once at least five contributors have opted in.
page.source: Source code and methodology on GitHub

calculator.hoursLabel: How long do you want Codex coding each day?
calculator.sessionHint: feature sessions a day, at 35 minutes each.
calculator.disclaimer: These are illustrative prices and assumed capacities, and the calculator has no measured allowance data yet, so I would check actual costs before choosing a subscription.
calculator.sample: Community token reports are reviewed separately. They do not measure subscription limits or coding hours.

contribution.generateIntro: Run the usage skill on your computer to create a local JSON file. It does not upload anything.
contribution.checkIntro: Select your report to inspect it here. Selecting a file does not send it to the server.
contribution.privacy: The report contains monthly totals by model, which can still reveal patterns of activity, and token counts cannot tell us your subscription limits or coding hours.
contribution.details: See exactly what will be shared
contribution.closed: Submissions aren't open yet. You can still check a report locally and manage an existing contribution after signing in.
contribution.consent: I have reviewed this report and agree to its private storage for up to 90 days, with the option to withdraw it.
contribution.optIn: Show my GitHub profile and avatar after my report is accepted, once at least five contributors have opted in.
contribution.withdrawConfirm: Delete your report and remove public attribution?
contribution.noScript: Enable JavaScript to inspect a report and manage your contribution. Nothing is submitted automatically.

messages.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 256 KB limit.
messages.invalidReport: This is not a supported aggregate usage report.
messages.loaded: Report checked locally. No report data has been sent.
messages.accepted: Your report has been accepted. Public attribution still depends on your choice and the contributor threshold.
messages.withdrawn: Your report and profile preference have been deleted.
messages.saved: Your profile preference has been saved.
messages.failed: The request could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again.
messages.changed: Your contribution changed in another request. Check its current status before trying again.
messages.signInFailed: GitHub sign-in could not be completed. Try signing in again.
